from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from typing import List

from beanie import PydanticObjectId, init_beanie
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Response, status
from pymongo import AsyncMongoClient

from models import Book
from schemas import BookCreate, BookRead, BookUpdate


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    client = AsyncMongoClient("mongodb://localhost:27017", tz_aware=True)
    await init_beanie(database=client.appdb, document_models=[Book])
    yield
    await client.close()

app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)


@app.post("/books", response_model=BookRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_book(book_in: BookCreate):
    book = Book(**book_in.model_dump())
    await book.insert()
    return BookRead(
        id=str(book.id),
        title=book.title,
        author=book.author,
        year=book.year,
        genres=book.genres,
    )


@app.get("/books", response_model=List[BookRead])
async def list_books():
    books = await Book.find_all().to_list()
    return [
        BookRead(
            id=str(b.id),
            title=b.title,
            author=b.author,
            year=b.year,
            genres=b.genres,
        )
        for b in books
    ]


@app.get("/books/{book_id}", response_model=BookRead)
async def get_book(book_id: str):
    book = await Book.get(PydanticObjectId(book_id))
    if not book:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Book not found")
    return BookRead(
        id=str(book.id),
        title=book.title,
        author=book.author,
        year=book.year,
        genres=book.genres,
    )


@app.put("/books/{book_id}", response_model=BookRead)
async def update_book(book_id: str, book_update: BookUpdate):
    book = await Book.get(PydanticObjectId(book_id))
    if not book:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Book not found")
    update_data = book_update.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    for field, value in update_data.items():
        if value is not None:
            setattr(book, field, value)
    await book.save()
    return BookRead(
        id=str(book.id),
        title=book.title,
        author=book.author,
        year=book.year,
        genres=book.genres,
    )


@app.delete("/books/{book_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
async def delete_book(book_id: str):
    book = await Book.get(PydanticObjectId(book_id))
    if not book:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Book not found")
    await book.delete()
    return Response(status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

# Helper payloads
BASE_PAYLOAD = {
    "title": "Sample Book",
    "author": "Jane Doe",
    "year": 2021,
    "genres": ["Fiction", "Adventure"]
}

INVALID_ID = "000000000000000000000000"


def create_book(client, payload=None):
    """Create a book via the API and return its JSON representation."""
    if payload is None:
        payload = BASE_PAYLOAD
    resp = client.post("/books", json=payload)
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    return resp.json()


def delete_book(client, book_id):
    """Delete a book via the API – used for cleanup."""
    resp = client.delete(f"/books/{book_id}")
    # Deleting an existing book should return 204
    assert resp.status_code == 204


def test_create_book():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        data = create_book(client)
        # Verify fields
        assert data["title"] == BASE_PAYLOAD["title"]
        assert data["author"] == BASE_PAYLOAD["author"]
        assert data["year"] == BASE_PAYLOAD["year"]
        assert data["genres"] == BASE_PAYLOAD["genres"]
        # Cleanup
        delete_book(client, data["id"])


def test_list_books():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        # Create two distinct books
        payload1 = {**BASE_PAYLOAD, "title": "Book One"}
        payload2 = {**BASE_PAYLOAD, "title": "Book Two"}
        book1 = create_book(client, payload1)
        book2 = create_book(client, payload2)

        resp = client.get("/books")
        assert resp.status_code == 200
        books = resp.json()
        ids = {b["id"] for b in books}
        assert book1["id"] in ids
        assert book2["id"] in ids

        # Cleanup
        delete_book(client, book1["id"])
        delete_book(client, book2["id"])


def test_get_book():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        created = create_book(client)
        book_id = created["id"]
        resp = client.get(f"/books/{book_id}")
        assert resp.status_code == 200
        data = resp.json()
        assert data == created
        # Cleanup
        delete_book(client, book_id)


def test_update_book():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        created = create_book(client)
        book_id = created["id"]
        update_payload = {"title": "Updated Title", "year": 2022}
        resp = client.put(f"/books/{book_id}", json=update_payload)
        assert resp.status_code == 200
        updated = resp.json()
        assert updated["title"] == "Updated Title"
        assert updated["year"] == 2022
        # unchanged fields remain the same
        assert updated["author"] == created["author"]
        assert updated["genres"] == created["genres"]
        # Cleanup
        delete_book(client, book_id)


def test_delete_book():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        created = create_book(client)
        book_id = created["id"]
        resp = client.delete(f"/books/{book_id}")
        assert resp.status_code == 204
        # Subsequent GET should be 404
        resp = client.get(f"/books/{book_id}")
        assert resp.status_code == 404


def test_get_book_404():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        resp = client.get(f"/books/{INVALID_ID}")
        assert resp.status_code == 404


def test_update_book_404():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        resp = client.put(f"/books/{INVALID_ID}", json={"title": "Nope"})
        assert resp.status_code == 404


def test_delete_book_404():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        resp = client.delete(f"/books/{INVALID_ID}")
        assert resp.status_code == 404
